I answered Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team. The Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

I got that from Ilse's message in #north-random on Oct 13. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could have seen it herself. Ilse said the ticket was open at that point and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets. I passed that warning along too. I haven't checked whether the ticket is still open today.

Dana also mentioned a ticket number to me privately in our direct messages, and she was clear it was only her guess. I didn't use it or bring it up in the channel.
